Reviewer: uma pool job review-4187 (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR unset; pool identity unavailable), GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney/mikekinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

CLEAN. No blocking changes found. The PR merges cleanly with main.

I read the full five-file diff and issue #3545. I used the current rules from upstream/main at `72890060b53a6dc836e8cee1d928226e11a4d753`. The local trial merge is `927998e78e5600a3b775306ff257958b27cd268f`; its first parent is the full PR head above.

The three command paths still refuse parameters at the same validation check. The helper changes only the error text after `is_sane` fails. The shared field limits agree with the parameter rules. The helper does not read nested wire tolerance fields. The new MCP test checks negative stepdown, negative stock allowance, and zero feed. It also checks that a refused edit does not change the operation and that a refused add creates no operation.

Mutations: not applicable. This PR changes diagnostics only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision or gouge checks, or stock simulation. No golden files moved. No UI files changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested changes: none.

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-4187`. No GitHub runner was used. The worktree and branch remain for the next review. Per the instruction for this review, I left the labels, title, and draft state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 4187 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
